run_openevolve_evolution: run an evolutionary coding agent on an initial program with an evaluation file
parse_args_cli: parse command-line arguments for the OpenEvolve evolutionary coding agent
run_with_checkpoint: resume an OpenEvolve evolution run from a saved checkpoint directory
run_with_model_override: run OpenEvolve with custom LLM API base and primary or secondary model names
run_with_target_score: run OpenEvolve evolution until a target score is reached or max iterations hit
